postings.title: Account Director, Enterprise
postings.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The Enterprise Account Director will lead our sales efforts, driving growth by seeking new business opportunities while fostering strong relationships with WPP & key clients. You will develop and execute strategic sales initiatives, focusing on acquiring net new accounts and expanding existing partnerships, ensuring we meet and exceed our revenue goals. 

A successful Account Director is a driven, results-oriented hunter with a relentless focus on opening new doors and securing net new business opportunities. You’ll use your proactive approach and adaptability to identify and engage with key decision-makers, consistently working to expand StackAdapt’s footprint. You'll work closely with StackAdapt Account Managers to grow and retain existing accounts by crafting tailored campaign strategies that meet clients' needs, building strong relationships, and delivering impactful results. Your main objective will be to fuel StackAdapt's growth by driving new business and establishing long-term client partnerships.

StackAdapt is a remote first company. We will be prioritizing candidates located in London for this role.

What you'll be doing:

- Prospect, identify and target new brands within untapped markets, using your expertise in lead generation to fill the sales pipeline with high-quality prospects.

- Take lead in responding to RFP’s or new inner agency opportunities, including qualification & win strategy

- Establish and cultivate relationships with top executives at WPP and their associated brands

- Engage in discussions about product development based on client feedback with senior stakeholders across sales, product and engineering

- Partner with your dedicated StackAdapt Account Manager to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new campaign strategies and solutions to clients, and building strong relationships

- Showcase the benefits of StackAdapt's media buying platform through detailed product demonstrations

- Accurately manage and communicate quarterly forecasts and pipeline

What you'll bring to the table:

- 5-10+ years experience at a DSP/SSP

- Experience in building and executing successful sales strategies from the ground up, with a proven track record of developing new business and driving growth.

- Deep understanding of client business goals with the ability to translate programmatic solutions to help drive success for clients while meeting sales targets. 

- Strong established network and relationships with decision-makers at hold-co advertising agencies, independent agencies, and brands

- A solutions oriented approach: ability to understand and communicate customer challenges and pain points and navigate internally to help solve challenges

- A deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem and DSP dynamics

- Ability to travel to meet with customers in-market and conduct senior-level presentations

- Strong communication, presentations skills, and story-telling ability

- Curious, eager to learn, and consistent strive for excellence

- Proven track record of exceeding revenue expectations

- Previous experience selling programmatic advertising

- Practical experience using AI tools or automation to improve operational efficiency or quality assurance.

- Strong communication, documentation, attention to detail, and judgment.

About StackAdapt’s Verticals and Performance Team

StackAdapt’s Verticals and Performance Team focuses on developing and leading strategic business technology initiatives within priority industries in order to strengthen our suite of programmatic adtech and martech solutions. We collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Analytics to design innovative, vertical-specific solutions that push the boundaries of programmatic advertising.

About the Role

The Senior Analyst, Verticals and Performance will work on projects and partnerships that will accelerate the development of vertical-specific advertising solutions and bring new innovations to market. This role blends technical problem-solving, data analysis, and business strategy, offering exposure to multiple cross-functional teams and direct opportunities to shape the future of programmatic solutions. 

While the preferred location is London, we’re happy to consider candidates based outside of the city. However, please note that the Senior Analyst will be required to travel to London on an ad-hoc basis.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Support the team in executing the technical roadmap for Tier 1 projects, including the development, testing and maintenance of targeting and measurement solutions. 

- Collaborate with Product, Revenue, Marketing, Business Intelligence, and Data Science teams to design, test, and iterate on vertical-focused initiatives.

- Collaborate with the Revenue team to understand customer needs, and existing AdTech and MarTech stack to identify revenue growth, retention, and collaboration opportunities

- Promote the adoption and education of existing solutions by partnering with internal enablement and marketing teams

- Contribute to analytics proof-of-concepts (POCs) with strategic clients; test and validate custom use cases to establish clear paths to productization. 

- Define and track performance OKRs (e.g., data benchmarks, measurement accuracy, lower-funnel KPIs) and communicate strategic impact to senior internal stakeholders. 

- Provide hands-on support with ad-hoc and daily operational tasks which include (but are not limited to) campaign reporting & measurement setup, ad-hoc data analysis and market & competitor research

What You’ll Bring To The Table

About the Data Solutions Team
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build Data Solutions, a new domain at StackAdapt. Data Solutions turns the data StackAdapt generates, licenses, and partners for into trusted, reusable data products. Those products power targeting, measurement, AI, and new products across the company.
You'll help shape the enablement layers that power numerous core features across StackAdapt, including Ivy, StackAdapt's AI assistant for marketers. You'll also combine our proprietary datasets with third-party data to generate new insights.
The data underneath is large and rich: billions of events a day across impressions, clicks, and conversions, plus partner and licensed datasets. Our core technologies include Flink, Spark, Kafka, Iceberg, Golang, and Kubernetes. If you want to build data products that people rely on, and help define how an AI-forward company uses its data, this role is for you.

• Design, build, and operate data products end to end, including audiences, signals, enrichments, and the APIs and services that expose them
• Build the foundational data layer that gives Ivy and other AI agents rich context on audiences, campaigns, inventory, and performance
• Develop streaming and batch pipelines with Flink, Spark, and Kafka that publish into our Iceberg-based data plane, with clear contracts for schema, freshness, and ownership
• Create reusable frameworks for onboarding third-party and partner data, so new providers can be added quickly and shared across products
• Turn raw platform data into insights, such as audience traits, inventory signals, and performance baselines, that improve targeting and recommendations
• Work closely with Product, Data Science, and external data partners to decide what to build and why

• Use AI tools and agents in your daily work, and help shape how the team builds with them

• 5+ years of experience as a backend, data, or platform software engineer, with strong coding skills in Java, Scala, Python, or Go
• A track record of shipping data products or platforms that other teams or customers depend on
• Hands-on experience with distributed processing, streaming, and lakehouse or warehouse technologies (e.g., Flink, Spark, Kafka, Iceberg, Redshift, ClickHouse, Trino)
• Strong grasp of data modeling, data contracts, and data quality at scale
• Product sense: you care who uses the data and whether it moves a business outcome
• Comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into well-scoped systems
• An AI-forward mindset, with hands-on use of AI tools and curiosity about building data that agents consume

Bonus Points
• Proficiency in Golang
• Experience working with privacy or legal teams on data use, such as consent, licensing, or clean rooms
• Experience building and shipping AI products or features, such as LLM-powered applications, agents, or recommendation systems
• Experience building data for ML or AI systems, such as features, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval, or MCP servers
• AdTech or MarTech experience
• Experience building data catalogs, marketplaces, or semantic layers

- True Cross-Border Exposure: Transition from Canadian tax into US and international regimes (including T106/T1134 filings, foreign affiliate rules, and multi-state compliance) with hands-on mentorship.

We are searching for a talented Staff Applied Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data Science Engineering team as we continue to expand our data science efforts. Our platform is connected to thousands of publishers and advertisers worldwide and as a result, we're dealing with millions of requests each second, making billions of decisions. We utilize the latest technologies to solve challenges in traffic, data storage, machine learning, and scalability.

Identity Team: The same person appears in advertising data under many online identifiers, such as cookies, mobile advertising IDs, IP addresses, and hashed emails, and each identifier captures only part of that person's activity. We are looking for a senior person who has built online identity graphs. An identity graph links the identifiers that co-occur across different data sets and resolves them into one coherent, stable identifier for each person or household. The right candidate has designed the matching logic that decides which identifiers belong together, has measured the accuracy and coverage of those links, and has kept the resulting identifier stable as the underlying identifiers change or expire. We use this identifier to target ads, so the candidate should also understand how identity quality affects reach and targeting accuracy.

Want to learn more about our Data Science Team: https://alldus.com/ie/blog/podcasts/aiinaction-ned-dimitrov-stackadapt/

Learn more about our team culture here: https://www.stackadapt.com/careers/data-science 

Watch our talk at Amazon Tech Talks: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lRqu-a4gPuU

What you'll be doing:

- Lead the creation and optimization of advanced machine learning algorithms—from developing new methods to refining existing techniques—to enhance advertising effectiveness and ROI using deep ML expertise

- Own the end-to-end development of production-grade ML models: write efficient, scalable code and collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers to deploy and integrate algorithms into live systems

- Drive the prototyping and rigorous testing of innovative algorithms and data pipelines using historical data to validate performance and scalability; lead iterative improvements based on data-driven insights

What you'll bring to the table:

- 5+ years of industry experience

- Proven depth of experience building online identity graphs, designing matching logic to resolve fragmented identifiers into stable consumer profiles, and measuring the impact of identity accuracy on ad targeting and reach

- Have a Masters degree or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field, with dual degrees a plus
